title: Frigidaire Commercial — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Frigidaire Commercial.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Commercial Tough." Value tier. Frigidaire Commercial is the foodservice and light commercial line — built tougher for restaurants, break rooms, and commercial kitchens. NSF-certified where applicable.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Small restaurants, break rooms, office kitchens, commercial applications.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Frigidaire Commercial:

• Commercial-grade build quality for business environments

• NSF-certified models available

• Electrolux commercial backing

• Lower cost than dedicated commercial brands

• Residential-to-commercial crossover for small businesses
